mapper.select: select * from public.vault_item where vault_id = #{vaultId} and generation = #{generation} and is_deleted = false order by item_id
mapper.update: update public.vault_item set is_deleted = true, delete_user = #{actor}, gmt_deleted = #{now}, update_user = #{actor}, gmt_modified = #{now}, row_version = row_version + 1 where vault_id = #{item.vaultId} and generation = #{item.generation} and item_id = #{item.itemId} and row_version = #{item.rowVersion} and is_deleted = false
mapper.delete: delete from public.vault_item i using public.vault_generation g, public.vault_info v where i.vault_id = #{vaultId} and i.item_id = #{itemId} and g.vault_id = i.vault_id and g.generation = i.generation and g.status in ('RETIRED', 'ABORTED') and v.id = i.vault_id and (v.active_generation is null or v.active_generation <> i.generation)
